chat_messages.text: Two of us ran terraform apply at the same time and corrupted the state file. We keep state in S3 but there's no locking.
Add a DynamoDB table and wire it in as the backend's lock table. S3 stores state, DynamoDB serializes writes, and a second apply blocks instead of racing.

content.text: Done — DynamoDB locking is in and I made state changes go through CI only, no local applies. That's a team rule now.

chat_messages.text: I get paged for CPU spikes that resolve themselves in 30 seconds. It's wrecking my on-call weeks and I've started ignoring alerts.
Alert on symptoms users feel, not resource numbers. Page on error rate and latency SLO burn; leave CPU as a dashboard signal with a long 'for' duration if you keep it at all.
